scope: Live field-property edits from accepted ScriptRunner results, and whether public form controls and submit-form diagnostics see the current view's effective flag state. MaxLen is excluded (owner review B67); no JavaScript engine or native UI execution is claimed.

source.locator: EC3 Table 227, printed p.532 / physical p.547
source.rule: ReadOnly: if set, processor shall not allow user value changes; associated widgets should not interact with clicks or mouse-move appearance changes. Required: if set, field shall have a value at submit-form export. NoExport: if set, field shall not be exported.

source.locator: EC3 §12.7.5.3 Table 231, printed p.539 / physical p.554
source.rule: The interactive processor shall obey text-field flag usage guidelines. `multiline`, `password`, `doNotScroll`, and `comb` are exposed as script-writable field properties; comb has the table's MaxLen and other-flag preconditions.

supported_property_inventory.read_only: Public JS `Field.readonly` setter maps to Property::ReadOnly; ViewState::set_field consults the override.
supported_property_inventory.required: Public JS `Field.required` setter maps to Property::Required; ADR1617 maps it to Table227 bit2 on save and `FieldState` applies it for later script events.
supported_property_inventory.no_export: No JS `Field.noExport` property or Property variant exists; the field flag remains read from the document and is honored by submit composition. No setter gap is claimed.

consumer_matrix.current_read: form::read constructs Field directly from document plus the annotation value; `read_only`, `required`, and TextControl flags are taken from Field::read(document). The result does not apply ViewState::script_properties.
consumer_matrix.coverage: script_properties.rs asserts saved/reopened Required and drawn appearance behavior; realm.rs asserts setter edit and same-run readback. No assertion found for the public form description after an unsaved live Required/ReadOnly/TextFlag edit.

consumer_matrix.current_read: ReadOnly is special-cased through script_read_only and blocks edits after a live true override.
consumer_matrix.coverage: No independent control test found that compares the resulting FormField.read_only metadata with the enforced edit result.

consumer_matrix.current_read: Submission reconstructs Field from the stored document and view annotation value; it does not overlay Property::Required. Static Required-empty reporting is covered by 2038-T121.
consumer_matrix.coverage: T121 tests stored Required flags and host policy. No live true/false Required override is compared against the diagnostic.

consumer_matrix.current_read: The bridge emits Property::TextFlag and records it in the realm overrides. ADR1615 explicitly keeps and reports these edits as not drawn; form::fields reads the stored field flags, while FieldState for subsequent script events reapplies overrides.
consumer_matrix.coverage: Engine members tests prove setter-to-edit and same-run getter behavior, but no public form-consumer assertion says unsaved TextFlag overrides alter native control shape. Treat that as the recorded project boundary unless an owner contract says otherwise.

residuals: The source clauses prescribe what the flag means when effective, but the precise live-script-to-native-control synchronization boundary is a project API/ADR question. Draft assertions test consistency with ADR1617/current FormField contract; they are not a claim that ISO itself mandates JavaScript execution.
ReadOnly click/hover behavior is a SHOULD in Table227 and not exercised by model set_field tests; this shard does not claim native toolkit conformance.
NoExport cannot be changed by the exposed Field API; its static serialization assertion is already in submission tests.
